content.value_statement: Code directories are hard to understand when signatures, dependencies, and relationships are scattered. This skill guides C4 code-level documentation with structured sections and diagrams.
actual_capabilities: Documents functions, methods, classes, modules, parameters, return types, and dependencies.
Creates C4 code-level summaries for a selected directory or module.
Suggests Mermaid diagram styles for object-oriented, functional, procedural, and mixed code.
Records source locations and descriptions for documented code elements.
Explains how code-level documentation differs from component, container, and context views.
limitations: It depends on access to the target code and clear directory boundaries.
It does not execute code or verify runtime behavior by itself.
It focuses on code-level documentation, not deployment or system context diagrams.
Optional Mermaid diagrams are best for complex relationships, not every small module.

use_cases.title: Document a Service Layer
use_cases.description: Create code-level documentation for classes, methods, and dependencies inside a service directory.

use_cases.title: Map Functional Pipelines
use_cases.description: Describe pure functions, transformation steps, and data flow through a processing module.

use_cases.title: Prepare Architecture References
use_cases.description: Turn source code analysis into consistent C4 code-level reference material for developers.

prompt_templates.title: Document One Directory
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this directory and create C4 code-level documentation with functions, classes, dependencies, and source locations.

prompt_templates.title: Add Code Relationships
prompt_templates.prompt: Document this module and include the most useful Mermaid diagram for its programming style.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Mixed Paradigms
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this mixed codebase and separate class relationships, function pipelines, and module dependencies.

prompt_templates.title: Create Review-Ready Docs
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce C4 code-level documentation for this component with clear boundaries, dependency notes, and diagram recommendations.

output_examples.input: Document the authentication module for a developer handoff.
output_examples.output: A structured document listing handlers, validators, helper functions, source locations, dependencies, and a recommended dependency diagram.

output_examples.input: Explain a data pipeline directory for maintainers.
output_examples.output: A C4 code-level summary with pipeline stages, transformation responsibilities, internal dependencies, and diagram guidance.

output_examples.input: Prepare code documentation for a mixed TypeScript package.
output_examples.output: Separate sections for classes, utility functions, modules, dependencies, and recommended diagrams for complex relationships.

best_practices: Start with a narrow directory or component boundary before expanding the documentation scope.
Include exact source locations so readers can verify each documented element.
Use Mermaid diagrams only when relationships are complex enough to benefit from a visual view.
anti_patterns: Do not document every file with the same depth when the request targets one component.
Do not add diagrams that repeat simple lists without improving understanding.
Do not mix code-level details with container or system context documentation.

faq.question: What C4 level does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers the code level, including functions, classes, modules, dependencies, and source locations.

faq.question: Can it create Mermaid diagrams?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends class, flowchart, or dependency diagrams when the code relationships are complex.

faq.question: Does it replace higher-level C4 diagrams?
faq.answer: No. It complements context, container, and component diagrams with lower-level implementation detail.

faq.question: What input works best?
faq.answer: A specific directory, module, or component works best, along with the documentation goal.

faq.question: Does it run or modify code?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes documentation steps and does not require code execution or file modification.

faq.question: Can it handle different programming styles?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for object-oriented, functional, procedural, and mixed codebases.
